answer: Unique State Delta Challenge. Each identity must submit a state transition no other identity has produced; the network stores only a compressed delta hash in a global index, rejecting repeats. A juniper-seeded nonce binds each submission to its identity. An attacker minting many identities pays compute plus the marginal cost of finding fresh, non-colliding deltas each cycle, and cannot reuse work across sybils. Honest agents preserve a private haven of unrepeatable history.
